name: C++17 parallel algorithms (std::execution::par / par_unseq)
listed_description: Execution policies from the standard execution header let existing STL algorithms such as sort, for_each and transform run on multiple cores or with vectorization by adding one argument.
claim_text: Parallel sort may enhance speed; policies can bring substantial performance improvements on large datasets. No numbers given; overhead can negate gains on small data.
found_in: book: Data Structures and Algorithms with the C++ STL (2024), ch. 22 Parallel Algorithms with the STL, sections 'Implementing parallel execution' and 'Performance considerations'

name: Shared-mutex guarded vector (ConcurrentVector)
listed_description: Toy container wrapping std::vector with std::shared_mutex so readers run concurrently and writers lock only for the insert; book uses it to show lock scope and granularity tips.
claim_text: Shared locking enables higher read throughput and minimal lock scope; no timings or baseline measured.
guessed_baseline: std::vector guarded by a plain std::mutex
found_in: book: Data Structures and Algorithms with the C++ STL (2024), ch. 20 Thread Safety and Concurrency with the STL, section 'Concurrent data structures in the STL / Best practices in action'
